kind: descriptive developmental evidence, one completed raw-food-only trajectory
study: seed211/full: finite soluble bootstrap, ongoing external raw-feedstock supply, shared anabolism and sorptive matrix
sampling: up to32 oldest living IDs, survivor-biased changing sample; same two IDs throughout this window
limits: within-ID changes include environmental input and division partition; repeated switching alone does not establish periodicity or adaptation; action logits/derived metabolic shares are not actual realized secretion or growth

recurrence_timing.crossing_rule: first recorded nonnegative value following a negative value; no interpolated crossing times
recurrence_timing.limits: sampled recurrence timing, not a fitted period or proof of an autonomous oscillator

late_sign_change_window.scope: oldest32 sample only; absence of sign changes is not absence of other dynamics

role_limits: last-step secretion means the actual .1-time-unit transfer, not cumulative lineage contribution; catalyst origin and functional dependence are not identified

coarse_full_population_late_check.limitations: 25-time-unit cadence can alias fast cycles; consecutive snapshots do not recover events between them; variability can include environment and division partition; not an adaptation or autonomous-oscillation assay
